792-4279-6794--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-6794--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4381-4694-5315-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.

When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.

2034-3480-6723-6970-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

4050-5258-5758-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 if Sunshower Druid is on top of your library.
4050-5258-5758-6900.description:
Cast Sunshower Druid either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Sunshower Druid enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature and causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sunshower Druid, adding {B}.
Activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Sunshower Druid from your graveyard onto the top of your library.

372-673-1090.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-673-1090.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

907-1479-5362.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Quantum Misalignment (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Izzet Chronarch and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3277-3378-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

1661-4871-5220-5686.description:

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
